name: code-graph
description: Extract, aggregate and explore application flows across many services

scripts.build: npm run build -w @codegraph/schema && npm run build -w @codegraph/extractor && npm run build -w @codegraph/aggregator && npm run build -w @codegraph/enrich && npm run build -w @codegraph/ui && npm run build -w @codegraph/cli
scripts.demo: npm run build && npm run extract:samples && npm run aggregate:samples && npm run ui:dev
